content.text: This matches the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: The renewal mechanics meet the preferred position in full. § 8.2 provides automatic renewals of twelve months only (no multi-year auto-renewal), a Customer opt-out on just thirty days' written notice (well inside the ≤30-day preferred window), and a Vendor reminder sixty days before renewal — plus an extra protection for us, since a missed reminder extends our opt-out deadline to thirty days after the reminder arrives. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, matching the preferred cap, with ninety days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods. The obligations here bind Vendor and the notice burden on us is minimal, so no redline is warranted.
